notes: total_seconds starts just before `flwr run` and ends when `flwr run --stream` exits, less check_seconds. It includes CLI start-up, the FAB build and upload, and the log stream's 0.5 s poll. SuperLink and SuperNode start-up is excluded and given as startup_seconds.
Waits before the timer until every SuperNode is online and every SuperExec is connected.

strategy_seconds is FedAvg alone, timed in the ServerApp. after_strategy_seconds runs from FedAvg returning to the CLI exiting. superlink_elapsed_seconds is running to finished as the SuperLink records it.
Stock polling stays in the numbers: SuperNode 3 s when idle, SuperExec 1 s, ServerApp 1 s. One ClientApp process starts per message, so per site per round.
SuperLink ran with --disable-runtime-dependency-installation, so no `uv sync` per run. State and objects are in memory, the SuperLink default.
Telemetry and the update check were off. Both apps read common.py through PYTHONPATH.
common.py's tensors are random and each site's update differs in every coordinate, so Flower's content-addressed chunks find nothing to deduplicate. network_bytes should be close to nominal_bytes.
Memory is summed RSS per process tree, so pages shared between processes count more than once. The `flwr run` CLI process is in neither group.
